clue.text: The lot getting past gravity excited …

parts.note: the lot means everything, all
past, as in 'years past', means ago
g is the physics symbol for gravitational acceleration

explanation.surface: Everybody gets worked up once they have got beyond seriousness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting' is only a link, and the pieces are written in the answer's order: ALL, then AGO, then G.
explanation.definitionFit: To be eager and agitated with anticipation is to be excited.

clue.text: A right objection to useless evergreen

parts.note: a but is an objection, as in 'no buts'
U/S stands for unserviceable, i.e. useless

explanation.surface: Someone raising a fair objection to a worthless tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The strawberry tree is an evergreen shrub of the heath family.

clue.text: Convict at back of trail.

parts.note: an old lag is a convict
behind means at the back of

explanation.surface: A prisoner at the end of a path.
explanation.definitionFit: To trail is to fall behind others.

clue.text: Information that is provided by supernatural spirit

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

explanation.surface: Knowledge supplied by a ghost.
explanation.definitionFit: A jinn in Arabian stories is a magic spirit.

clue.text: Obtained circular papers to be printed

parts.note: got means obtained
O is circular in shape
the press is the newspapers collectively

explanation.surface: Bought round newspapers ready for printing.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper that is sent off to the printers is put into print.

clue.text: … swindler responsible for transplant

explanation.surface: Following on from the previous clue, a con artist turns out to have done the transplant.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis joins this clue to 1 Across for the surface only; the clue is a double definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A con man is a crook in slang, and one who grafts tissue or a shoot carries out a transplant.

clue.text: Urchin spends morning in strong drink

indicators.note: in says the morning goes inside the drink

parts.note: gin is a strong spirit
AM is short for ante meridiem, morning

explanation.surface: A street child spends the morning drinking hard liquor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spends' is only a link; 'in' puts AM inside GIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A gamin is a street child, a ragamuffin.

clue.text: A doctor (with it) promises to pay for seeking distinction

parts.note: MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree
taken as written
IOUs are written promises to pay debts

explanation.surface: A trendy doctor writes promissory notes to buy prestige.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link, and 'for' joins wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone keen on success or advancement is eager for distinction.

clue.text: Upbraid old Bob getting in tangle

indicators.note: getting in says the coin is placed inside the scolding word

parts.note: to twit is to taunt or upbraid
a bob was a shilling, abbreviated s, in old British money

explanation.surface: Someone tells off an old man called Bob who has got into a mess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bob' looks like a name; it is old slang for a shilling, abbreviated S.
explanation.definitionFit: A twist in a line can be a kink or tangle.

clue.text: Beer upset newsman when feasted

indicators.note: upset in a down clue turns the beer word upside down, read backwards

parts.note: lager is a beer
ED for editor, a newspaper man

explanation.surface: A journalist knocks over the beer at a banquet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns LAGER into REGAL.
explanation.definitionFit: To regale guests is to entertain them lavishly with food and drink.

clue.text: Pray at home for Middle East leader

parts.note: to pray someone for something is to beg
being in means being at home

explanation.surface: A request to pray at home on behalf of a Middle Eastern ruler.
explanation.walkthrough: Menachem Begin was Prime Minister of Israel from 1977 to 1983.
explanation.definitionFit: Begin was an Israeli prime minister, a political head in the Middle East.

clue.text: See how fast creature is giving present

parts.note: to see how fast something goes is to time it
a being is any living creature

explanation.surface: Checking how quickly an animal runs while it hands over a gift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is giving' is the link; 'present' looks like a gift but means the present moment, as in 'for the time being'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means the current period, now, as in 'for the time being'.

clue.text: Article engineers take on immediately afterwards

parts.note: 'the' is the definite article
RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army
upon is a longer form of on

explanation.surface: A piece of writing, which engineers take on next.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take' is a link word between the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an old-fashioned adverb meaning straight after that, at once.

clue.text: Child needs a pound to complete …

parts.note: a tot is a small child
L is the abbreviation for pound sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: A youngster needs a pound to finish the set.
explanation.definitionFit: Total as an adjective means entire, whole.

clue.text: … part of Ireland sounding cunning on leave

indicators.note: sounding says the word for cunning is only to be heard, not spelt as usual

parts.note: cunning means sly
to leave is to go

explanation.surface: A sly Irish region heads off on holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links to 12 Across for the surface only. 'on' just sets GO after the heard SLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Sligo is a county and town in the north-west of the Republic of Ireland.

clue.text: New Year honour is going to a northern church with due deference

parts.note: the OBE is a British honour often awarded in the New Year Honours list
taken as written
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: An honour recipient goes to a northern church with proper respect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going to' and 'with' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Obeisance is a bow or gesture showing respect.

clue.text: Fully occupied in being expressed in legal form

explanation.surface: Someone absorbed in drafting a formal legal document.
explanation.definitionFit: Absorbed means fully occupied, and to engross a deed is to write it out in final legal form.

clue.text: Faint-feeling soldier takes divine over one Scots loch

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
DD is Doctor of Divinity, a divine
I is the Roman numeral one
Loch Ness is in Scotland

explanation.surface: A soldier with a clergyman feels faint by a Scottish loch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes' and 'over' are links; the pieces come in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Dizziness makes one feel faint.

clue.text: High-hat catches flue

explanation.surface: A tall hat catches the chimney soot.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall cylindrical silk hat is named after a smoke pipe, and a stove's chimney pipe is a flue.

clue.text: About to get in habit of being corrected

parts.note: re means about, concerning
habit is clothing, so being in habit is being dressed

explanation.surface: A nun about to put on her habit of being put right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get' and 'of being' are links; 'habit' is dress, as a nun's habit, not a routine.
explanation.definitionFit: To redress a wrong is to set it right, so the word means put right.

clue.text: Can it be the parson to stay with again?

parts.note: Rev is short for Reverend, a parson
the question 'can it be?' is 'is it?'

explanation.surface: A doubtful question whether the parson is the one to stay with once more.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the clue as 'is it the rev?' with the pieces written REV then IS IT.
explanation.definitionFit: To revisit people is to go back and stay with them again.

clue.text: Exclusive southern trading association

parts.note: a co-op is a cooperative trading society

explanation.surface: A cooperative business in the South with an exclusive deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper story printed first and only by one paper is an exclusive.

clue.text: Sign for future wine with ten ingredients

parts.note: port is a fortified wine

indicators.note: ingredients are mixed, so the three letters of ten are mixed up

explanation.surface: An omen read in wine made with ten ingredients.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ingredients' mixes TEN into ENT after PORT.
explanation.definitionFit: An omen is a sign of what is to come.

clue.text: Beauty of victory in Europe by students' union

parts.note: VE Day marked Victory in Europe in 1945
the NUS is the National Union of Students in Britain

explanation.surface: A lovely thing celebrated at the end of the war by the students' union.
explanation.definitionFit: The goddess of love's name stands for any beautiful woman.

clue.text: Impracticable either way

indicators.note: either way says the letters read the same forwards and backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Something unworkable whichever way you look at it.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying a plan is not on means it cannot be done, unacceptable.

clue.text: Soldier with some hesitation joins predatory vessel

parts.note: a private is the lowest-ranking soldier
er is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A soldier hesitantly joins a pirate ship.
explanation.definitionFit: It was an armed ship licensed by a government to raid enemy merchant shipping.

clue.text: Two old coppers enter salary of Irishman

indicators.note: enter says the coppers go inside the salary word

parts.note: pay is salary
d was an old British penny, a copper coin, so two are DD

explanation.surface: Two former policemen join the payroll of an Irishman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' look like police but are copper coins, old pennies (d). 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Paddy is a nickname for an Irishman, from Padraig.

clue.text: A biblical letter writer heard with dismay

indicators.note: heard says the apostle's name is only to be spoken, not spelt

parts.note: St Paul wrote many of the New Testament epistles

explanation.surface: A scriptural correspondent is listened to with horror.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link. A PAUL said aloud sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To appal is to horrify, filling someone with dismay.

clue.text: Irritate party attached to border

parts.note: a set is a group of people, a party
on means attached to, as a lid is on a jar
an edge is a border

explanation.surface: A group of people stuck to the border.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase is used as in 'set one's teeth on edge'.
explanation.definitionFit: To put someone on edge is to make them tense and annoyed.

clue.text: Very proper oriental chief

parts.note: prim means very proper, prudish
E for eastern, oriental

explanation.surface: A strait-laced Eastern leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Prime means first in importance, main.

clue.text: Sent incorrectly to cathedral in a nail-biting way

indicators.note: sent incorrectly says the four letters arrived in the wrong order

parts.note: Ely in Cambridgeshire is a cathedral city often clued this way

explanation.surface: Something misdirected to the cathedral, causing anxiety.
explanation.walkthrough: 'incorrectly' rearranges SENT into TENS before ELY.
explanation.definitionFit: Nail-biting means anxious and strained, so doing something that way is doing it with nerves taut.

clue.text: Outstanding champion boxer posted outside

indicators.note: posted outside says the word for posted goes round the boxer

parts.note: posted a letter means sent it
Muhammad Ali was a world heavyweight champion

explanation.surface: A great fighter's letter was posted from abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts SENT round ALI.
explanation.definitionFit: A salient point is prominent, one that stands out.
